answer: A farm dies on the first hurdle when the hurdle is Malt shoveller mash tun proof fermented in the wort cellar, and the hurdle is each mash tun is a season of logged brewhouse readings plus a signed mash record, so. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 93 POA and 14 minutes each, 49197 POA and 7406 minutes in all. Judge it by the relic: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the umber: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the garden: a file that outlives the farm. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
